authority.source_of_truth: Reviewed portfolio source, exact project/source references, author metadata, publication manifests, and whole-tree candidate identities.
authority.task_authority: GitHub issues and publication specifications with accessibility, performance, source, and disclosure acceptance criteria.
authority.acceptance_authority: Clean site builds, publication-contract validation, browser tests, accessibility/performance checks, and reviewed source/model provenance.
authority.deployment_authority: Protected publication workflow; public candidate validation is separate from production-site mutation.

data.retention: Published source, project references, candidate manifests, build identities, and corrections remain historically traceable.
data.deletion: Removed projects or private/restricted source references are withdrawn from active publication and corrected through retained history.
data.secret_storage: Deployment credentials and private project evidence remain outside the public repository.

change_control.rollback_or_revocation: Published candidates are content-addressed and replaceable; compromised links, projects, or grants can be removed through reviewed redeployment.

stabilization.summary: Move publication, provenance, disclosure, performance, and source rules into one versioned machine-readable contract.
Generate contributor and publication documentation from the canonical contract to prevent prose drift.
Retain exact browser, viewport, accessibility, performance, screenshot, and candidate evidence for published builds.
